methods.name: _overview
methods.summary: Whether Docker can be reached, how the DNS server's container is doing, and the settings and names it is made from. A Docker that cannot be reached is an answer (`engine.reachable` is false and says why), not an error.

methods.name: _connect
methods.summary: Choose the Docker the server runs in, and answer with what is there. A server left running in the Docker chosen before is not touched.

params.name: host
params.description: Where Docker listens: `unix:///path/docker.sock`, `tcp://host:2375` or `http://host:2375`. Empty for this machine's own Docker.

errors.message: The address is not one Docker can be reached at.

methods.name: _set_enabled
methods.summary: Turn the server on (its container is made from the settings and the names, and started) or off (its container is removed; the settings and the names stay). What Docker refused is said by `server.problem` of the answer.

methods.name: _apply
methods.summary: Make the container again from the settings and the names as they stand, and start it: the way out when it is not running, or was made from older ones. Does nothing while the server is off.

methods.name: _save_settings
methods.summary: Change the port the server answers on, who it asks for the names it does not know, and whether it logs each question. A server that is on is made again with them.

params.name: port
params.description: The port of the machine Docker runs on that the server answers on, UDP and TCP. DNS is 53.

params.name: upstreams
params.description: The addresses (IPv4 or IPv6) of the DNS servers asked for every name that is not one of the records. None: only the records are answered.

params.name: logQueries
params.description: Write every question and its answer to the log.

errors.message: An upstream server is not an IP address: the message says which.

methods.name: _create_record
methods.summary: Give a name an address. A server that is on is made again with it.

params.name: name
params.description: The name, like `nas.home`: letters, digits and hyphens, in parts joined by dots.

params.name: address
params.description: The address the name answers with, IPv4 (`192.168.1.10`) or IPv6 (`fd00::10`). A name may have several.

params.name: subdomains
params.description: Every name under it answers with the address too (`photos.nas.home` for `nas.home`).

errors.message: The name or the address is not one, the name has that address already, or there are too many records: the message says which.

methods.name: _delete_record
methods.summary: Take a record away. A server that is on is made again without it.

params.name: record
params.description: The id of one of the records of `overview`.

methods.name: _logs
methods.summary: The end of what the server has written: how it started, what it could not do, and every question when the settings ask for that.

params.name: tail
params.description: How many lines from the end; 200 when left out.

errors.message: Docker cannot be reached, or the server has no container: the message says which.

methods.name: list_records
methods.description: The names this machine's DNS server answers for, each with its address (IPv4 or IPv6) and whether every name under it answers with the address too; the servers it asks for every other name (`upstreams`); and how the server is doing: whether it is wanted on (`enabled`), the state of its container (`running`, `stopped`, `restarting`, or `absent` when there is none), the port it answers on, and why it is not running when Docker refused (`problem`).

methods.name: add_record
methods.description: Give a name an address on this machine's DNS server (`nas.home` -> `192.168.1.10`). A name may have several addresses: add each. A server that is on answers with it a moment later; one that is off keeps it for when it is turned on.

params.name: subdomains
params.description: Every name under it answers with the address too; false when left out

methods.name: remove_record
methods.description: Take a name away from this machine's DNS server, by the name as `list_records` gives it: every address it has, or only `address` when given.

params.name: address
params.description: One of the name's addresses; all of them when left out

methods.name: changed
methods.summary: The server's container changed, or the configuration did: the open windows read the overview again.

version.description: Docker's version, empty when it cannot be reached.

host.description: Where Docker is looked for, as given to `connect`. Empty for this machine's own Docker.

problem.description: Why Docker cannot be reached, as a sentence. Empty when it can.

ServerState.description: How the server's container is doing: there is none, it runs, Docker is starting it again, or it is there and not running.

enabled.description: The server is wanted on. Whether it is running is `state`.

status.description: Docker's own words for the container: `Up 2 hours`, `Exited (2) 5 seconds ago`. Empty without one.

current.description: The container was made from the settings and the names as they stand. False without one.

image.description: The image the container is made from.

problem.description: Why the container could not be made or started the last time it was tried, as a sentence. Empty when it could.

port.description: The port the server answers on, UDP and TCP.

upstreams.description: The DNS servers asked for every name that is not one of the records.

logQueries.description: Every question and its answer is written to the log.

name.description: The name, in lower case and without a dot at its end.

address.description: The IPv4 or IPv6 address the name answers with.

subdomains.description: Every name under it answers with the address too.

records.description: Every record, by name and then by address.

truncated.description: The text is the end of something longer.
